description: Hierarchical navigation path, showing the current page.

howToUse: Use it at the top of a page that sits deep in a hierarchy, so people see where they are and go back up: Projects / Refy / Settings.
Each level except the last is a link; the last one is the current page.
Long paths fold the middle into a menu after `collapseAfter` levels.
alternatives: Switching between sections at the same level: Tabs or NavigationMenu.

keyboard.action: Moves from one level to the next.
Opens the level in focus. On the folded part, opens the menu with the hidden levels.

props.name: root
props.description: Optional destination of the home icon.

props.name: collapseAfter
props.description: From this count on, the middle becomes a Menu. Default 5.
